Name: Salma, Son of Caleb
Summary: Son of Caleb son of Hur, called the father of Beth-lehem.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:51: Son of Caleb son of Hur, called the father of Beth-lehem.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Salma stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
